Whole-Stack Rod Viewer

Every rod found by the cylinder-matching pipeline in a whole image stack.

Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag to pan. Click a rod to read its numbers. Rods are drawn at their measured radius, straightened to within one voxel of the traced centreline.
